method.method_draft: First describe the image as a truth table with four inputs D0-D3 and outputs X0, X1, V. Then note that V is 1 for every row except the all-zero input row, matching the text statement that V indicates valid input. Observe that when D1=1, D0 is marked x; when D2=1, D0 and D1 are x; when D3=1, D0-D2 are x. This means the larger-index asserted input overrides lower-index inputs. The output bits encode the selected input as 00, 01, 10, 11. Conclude the function is a priority encoder.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：V 只在全零输入行等于 0，其余有有效输入的行都等于 1，符合题目给出的“V=1 当且仅当输入有效”。表中当 D1=1 时 D0 为 x，当 D2=1 时 D0、D1 为 x，当 D3=1 时 D0、D1、D2 都为 x，说明较高编号的有效输入会覆盖较低编号输入，即存在优先级。输出 X0、X1 分别给出被选中输入的二进制编码 00、01、10、11。因此该真值表表示的功能是优先编码器。
